whyUs.title: Why Choose Barcelona Taxi Transfer
whyUs.subtitle: Uncompromising safety, punctuality, and comfort for discerning visitors.
whyUs.item1Desc: No hidden toll charges, no night surcharges, and no surprise surge rates. What you see is what you pay.
whyUs.item2Desc: English-speaking, licensed, courteous professionals with deep knowledge of Barcelona's routes.
whyUs.item3Desc: Enjoy 60 minutes complimentary waiting at BCN Airport, 30 minutes at Cruise Port, and 15 minutes in the city.
whyUs.item4Desc: We track your flight arrival in real-time and provide 24/7 customer support via phone and WhatsApp.

about.title: Barcelona's Most Trusted Private Transfer Service
about.desc1: Founded in the heart of Barcelona, we are a licensed private vehicle transportation company (VTC) offering premium transfers across the entire Catalan metropolitan region.
about.desc2: Our fleet of luxury Mercedes-Benz vehicles, combined with a team of professional, multilingual chauffeurs, ensures an unparalleled travel experience tailored to the needs of every passenger.
